per_candidate.id: s2:The Role of Baryons and Neutrinos in the Evolution of Large-Scale Structure, 2018-09-04

rationale: Papers 1801.08501, 2105.12108, and 2008.11285 directly investigate the tension between CMB and LSS constraints on Omega_m and sigma_8, exploring potential explanations such as dynamical dark energy and new physics beyond the standard model. They provide substantive new evidence but do not fully resolve the question.
